mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, d.title AS document_title, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.metadata::text AS metadata, 1 - (c.embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.citrus.knowledge.handler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector) AS similarity FROM knowledge_chunk c LEFT JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE 1 - (c.embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.citrus.knowledge.handler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector) >= #{minScore} AND d.status = 2 ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT #{topK}

WITH vector_matches AS ( SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.metadata::text AS metadata, 1 - (c.embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.citrus.knowledge.handler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector) AS vector_score FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.status = 2 AND 1 - (c.embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.citrus.knowledge.handler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector) >= #{minScore} ), keyword_matches AS ( SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.metadata::text AS metadata, ts_rank( to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(c.content, '')), plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) ) AS keyword_score FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.status = 2 AND to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(c.content, '')) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) ) SELECT COALESCE(v.id, k.id) AS id, COALESCE(v.document_id, k.document_id) AS document_id, d.title AS document_title, COALESCE(v.chunk_index, k.chunk_index) AS chunk_index, COALESCE(v.content, k.content) AS content, COALESCE(v.metadata, k.metadata) AS metadata, -- 加权融合：向量 0.7 + 关键词 0.3 COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) * 0.7 + COALESCE(k.keyword_score, 0) * 0.3 AS similarity FROM vector_matches v FULL JOIN keyword_matches k ON v.id = k.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = COALESCE(v.document_id, k.document_id) ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT #{topK}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (document_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, embedding, metadata, token_count, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.documentId}, #{item.chunkIndex}, #{item.content}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.embedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.citrus.knowledge.handler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector, #{item.metadata}::jsonb, #{item.tokenCount}, NOW())
